API Documentation Specialist - Cobalt Meadow Insurance

About the role
Cobalt Meadow is opening its partner APIs to external developers and needs excellent documentation. The team works in two-week sprints, holds weekly demos and keeps documentation next to the code. Engineers pair often, give honest feedback and set aside time every sprint to improve tooling, and new colleagues are paired with a buddy for their first month.

Responsibilities
- Write and maintain API reference and guides
- Work with engineers to keep content accurate
- Improve documentation tooling

Requirements
- REST API documentation
- OpenAPI specifications
- Markdown and Git workflows
- Editing and style guide ownership
- Experience with a static site generator

Nice to have
- Video tutorials

Benefits
- Flexible working hours and a yearly learning budget
- 25 days of paid leave plus public holidays
- We review every application and reply within two weeks
